title: Full Software playback without cross-origin isolation

definition.hypothesis: Existing cooperative mpv can be extended to finite-file software video plus consumed-audio feedback without shared memory.
definition.scope_contract: Implement a bounded finite-file private Software prototype on both JSPI and Asyncify.
definition.baseline: Existing isolated Software with the same media; reuse verified private mpv infrastructure.
definition.success_criteria: See README: actual reference pictures/audio, A/V timing, seek, cancellation and cleanup; renderer screen is a narrower gate.
definition.stop_criteria: Unsafe reentry/scheduling, unbounded queues, or inability to satisfy the declared workload without weakening fidelity.
definition.primary_metric: Additional correctly qualified playback capability without isolation.
definition.negative_control: Shared memory forbidden; JSPI absent in Asyncify; invalid render size rejected.
definition.effort_limit: Dedicated worktree prototype: private video build, decoded-picture/seek correctness, then synchronized stereo audio/video; no automatic public qualification.

define.basis: Source-grounded finite Software prototype contract and explicit investigation boundary.

prepare.basis: Verified fresh playback libraries and pinned SDK; static private-memory/continuation audits; independent FFmpeg references for six real README rows.

screen.basis: Actual private full mpv Software host decoded all six ordinary row fixtures on JSPI and forced Asyncify without isolation.

correctness.basis: Bounded experimental prototype/Backend gates: 18 continuous cases with current host/PCM/worklet/engine bindings, 23 installed lifecycle/fault scenarios per runtime, current Backend controls/negative cases on three browser/runtime combinations, isolated baseline, long-GOP and bounded HD output. Public Player and full parity remain unqualified; failed variants retained.

performance.basis: Requires a declared workload and passing media correctness first.

results.basis: Successful and failed variants retained with source snapshots, exact commands, independent references, build identities and hashed manifests.

decision.basis: Pursue maintained public Software integration from the working prototype; no current public route or shipping qualification change.

current_decision.evidence_level: bounded public Chromium Software and Hybrid plus direct continuous Backend features
current_decision.scope: JSPI and Asyncify; original six Software fixtures and five additional codec fixtures; stereo finite source limits remain
current_decision.rationale: Public integration and full codec build work in bounded tests. Full format and feature parity, Firefox, long/large inputs, regressions and exact release consumers remain pending.
current_decision.next_action: Complete source, format and public feature coverage, Firefox and exact release qualification.

next_action: Complete source, format and public feature coverage, Firefox and exact release qualification.
